scope: Elementary exact local-Schmidt operator and rank-one inertia reconstructions used in 121, including zero Schmidt coefficients and equality; no new input family or independent review.
local_schmidt_operator: For a normalized pure four-qubit sigma and a single site i, Schmidt-decompose |v>=sum_{j=1}^r sqrt(lambda_j)|j>_i|j>_rest, r<=2. Let K=I_rest tensor sigma_i, with the site restored to its actual position. On supp K, K^{-1/2}|v>=sum_{j=1}^r |j>_i|j>_rest has squared norm r. Thus K^{-1/2} sigma K^{-1/2} is a rank-one PSD operator of norm r<=2, proving K>=sigma/2. Zero Schmidt coefficients are omitted on supp K, where sigma is supported; no inverse is taken on ker K. When r=1 the stronger K>=sigma holds. The same inequality holds after full spin flip, preserving purity.
summed_margin: Summing the four physical site inequalities gives H1(sigma)>=2sigma and M=H1(sigma)-sigma>=sigma>=0. Consequently H1(rho)+tilde rho=4I-M(tilde rho) has lambda1<=4 for every actual pure rho, including product and maximally mixed local-marginal endpoints. This is an input-side statement; it does not by itself prove an all-Q frame inequality.
rank_one_inertia: For Hermitian A>=0 and any vector v, every vector in v^perp has nonnegative quadratic form for A-vv^dagger. Hence its negative spectral subspace has dimension at most one: a two-dimensional negative subspace would intersect v^perp nontrivially. This proof uses strictly negative eigenvalues, so zero eigenvalues at a tie do not create a second negative. Applying A=H1(sigma)-I>=0 when s>=1 yields lambda2(H1(rho)+tilde rho)<=3 by the exact 4I-M order reversal.
equalities_and_scope: For s=1 the diagonal A can be singular and rank-one subtraction may give a zero or one negative eigenvalue; the non-strict inequality survives without a determinant or zero inverse. For s=0 the pure state is product, but only its output spectrum is automatically equal to reference; arbitrary fixed Q may be strict (127). No universal harmonic W inequality, full k3, independent review or novelty follows. The five source corrections, two cadence findings and 149 withdrawal remain.
